methods.title: Printed mirror glyphs across Issue 24
methods.scope: Compare original ink and exact horizontal reflection in the 114 saved G07 regions, then inspect the full scans of printed pages 73–80 in 32 overlapping native tiles. Inspect the same faint heading feature in the second retained scan before showing the readers the page 75 reference.
methods.result: Neither reader recognized a reading instruction. A lossless turn clarified the one disputed banknote crop. The original disagreement remains in the review. A box-coverage audit found 83 normal-view boxes wholly outside these windows. The full-page review reported no reversed letters or reading instruction and left 17 reports unclear. The reflected page 74 heading resembles ordinary printing on page 75. In the lower-resolution scan, both readers marked the same faint band with zero agreed words. They both read page 75, leaving the association inconclusive under the declared rule.
